abilities.name: Tactical Versatility
abilities.text: Your training has prepared you for any circumstance. When you make a Critical Hit you may roll twice on the Critical Hit Table and choose either result.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Lightning Assault
abilities.text: Favouring fast-attack bikes to achieve their famed agile strikes, White Scars are proficient at attacking at speeds that would be otherwise unwieldy. You may reroll Double Rank dice once each time you make a Pilot (A) Test. You triple your Speed when you Charge (p.188).

abilities.name: Ritual Scarring (Tradition)
abilities.text: Inductees to the chapter mark the flesh of their faces deeply with their blades. You suffer a +1 DN penalty to any Fellowship-based Test made against any target that could be frightened of your appearance.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Courage (+1 Resolve); Accomplishment Badge of Honour (+1 Influence); Goal Honour the Chapter (+1 Conviction).

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Built Tough
talents.text: You can use Survival (Wil) instead of Medicae (Int) to remove your own Wounds, Shock, or Conditions … You do not suffer the usual DN penalties for using this ability on yourself.

gear: Duelling Grip on the Power Sword (Rubicon Uncommon item, Core p.228): +1 bonus die on Attack Tests using this weapon
Kraken Bolt rounds (AP −2, Core p.231; BOLT weapons only)
